name: Commentarr
description: Shared, timestamped comments in the player. See what everyone else said at this exact moment.

versions.changelog: Second screen for TV apps: while something plays on your TV, open Jellyfin on your phone and tap the Comments pill. The full comment panel follows the TV to within a fraction of a second, pins your comments to its moment, jumps it to a tapped time, and has Play/Pause.

Spoiler toggle when posting: spoiler comments stay covered until someone taps to read them, everywhere including the live panel. Writers and server admins can mark or unmark a spoiler later. The viewer setting is now Hide ahead, which also covers comments from later episodes.

Comments always land on the title you are watching. The overlay keeps recent moments first, rotates in the best comments from this title and the rest of the show, and steps aside when there is nothing to show. On wide screens the sidebar sits beside the video. Pin to the current moment is now opt-in.
The comments button now sits in the player control row with the other buttons. Overlay mode is a small, always-on panel of the four latest moments (three on a phone) with a one-line composer.
First release: overlay and sidebar modes, pinned moments, replies, likes, spoiler mode, live updates, reports and per-server moderation.
